newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity seen firm on profit rise.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity seen firm on profit rise.

text.p: Shares in Lucas Industries were expected to strengthen on Tuesday after the company reported better-than-expected pretax profits.
In its last annual results statement before the merger to form LucasVarity Plc pretax profits before exceptional items rose 41 percent to 191 million stg.
Shares in LucasVarity were up 1/2p at 250p in pre-market trade at 0707 GMT.
"The results are good, and above the consensus estimate," said Zafar Khan, engineering analyst at SGST. "With a particularly good performance on the aerospace side."
Lucas Aerospace more than doubled operating profit to 46.7 million stg from 21.1 million stg.
"This was considerably better than I had expected," Khan said. "I was looking for something around 30 million."

Khan said he would now be focusing on cost reductions in the newly merged LucasVarity group. The analyst will also revise his annualised forecast to January 1997 upwards to around 335 million stg, from 325 stg before.
